entry.title: Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII v0.5.1
entry.content:
# Changelog - Added train pass items to unlock Wildlands, Yusnaan, Dead Dunes. An option to start with these has also been added - Changed Mystery Egg to now unlock Ultimate Lair access - Removed being able to access Ultimate Lair from the Ark, now must be reached from the Dead Dunes cactuar teleport - Added Max EP, Max ATB, Item Capacity items into the pool - Added Bhakti's Oil and Bhakti's rewards as items/locations - The Things She Lost quest now requires either the Red or Green Carbuncle Doll logically - Last One Standing quest is now completable. Does not require the Final Day omegas anymore - Luka's Tear quest can be completed all in one day - Soul Seeds are now given from the Loupe, replacing the junk medal items that used to be there - Pilgrim's Cruxes moved down to Useful
# Notes - If you are upgrading Nova Chrysalia mod manager from 1.X to 2.X, uninstall all mods from Nova 1.X first, extract Nova 2.X to a new location, and install all your previous mods in Nova 2.X. - EN Text is required. Text for other languages is not supported due to maintainability concerns with the duplicated data.
# Known Issues/Limits - Items sent to you are retrieved by holding the sprint button on the field (L2/R2 or LT/RT). This is a workaround to avoid crashes when trying to add automatically with no input. - Game overs are removed so you can technically get to the final day without completing the 5 main quests. This is safer for AP, but obviously that would be out of logic by skipping everything. - Recovery items received from AP while your recovery item bag is full will be lost
# Troubleshooting - Do NOT use the File > Reboot option in game, always close the game and relaunch through Nova - In Nova, always launch the game in Unpacked mode with "Voice Over Setting" set to the language you unpacked data for.
If you still have issues without not seeing modded content: 1. Delete unpacked game data in Nova 2. Unpack game data again in Nova 3. Regenerate the rando modpack 4. Uninstall and remove the old modpack in Nova, and re-install the modpack 5. Be sure to launch the game in Unpacked and in the same voice language as unpacked data (EN/JP)!
# Setup Guide:
Download the following:
- lrff13.apworld - LRRandomizer#.#.#.#.7z - [Nova Chrysalia mod manager v2.0.3](https://mega.nz/file/24gyiB7b#nTIlktJb8ZCo8dXZDxCgwsdHAUDPURQhixSfucypIVg)
### AP World and Seed Setup 1. Double click the lrff13.apworld to install the custom world 6. Run the Archipelago Launcher (ArchipelagoLauncher.exe) 7. Click `Generate Template Options` to open the folder with the template yaml files 8. Copy the `Lightning Returns Final Fantasy XIII.yaml` template to the `Players` folder 9. Open your YAML file and edit the `name: Player{number}` to set your name. `{number}` is needed if there will others in the seed with a similar name, you can remove it otherwise. Modify any other options you want below. 10. If hosting: Run the Archipelago Launcher (ArchipelagoLauncher.exe) 11. Click `Generate` 12. Go the `output` folder, and you will find your created `AP_#####.zip` file. 13. To host the game, upload `AP_#####.zip` to: https://archipelago.gg/uploads
### Randomizer Seed Setup
1. Extract the Nova Chrysalia.7z to a folder of your choosing (using Windows, 7zip, etc). 2. Run Nova Chrysalia for the first time and select under Global Installation: "Unpack Game Data (EN Audio)" or "Unpack Game Data (JP Audio)" for the language audio you prefer - Note: You may need to launch LR normally from Steam first 4. Once the AP room is created, click the "Download Patch File" link to download a .aplrff13 mod file. 5. Extract `LRRandomizer#.#.#.#.7z` to a folder of your choosing. 6. Open the extracted folder and run LRRando.exe 7. On the `1. Setup` page and at the top, setup the paths to your Steam LR FFXIII folder and Nova. 8. At the bottom of the `1. Setup` page, click `Load from ZIP/APLRFF13` and select your .aplrff13 file 9. After you do this, the randomizer should switch to 'Archipelago Mode' 14. On the `2. Flags` page, select any additional settings 15. On the `3. Finish` page, click `Generate Modpack` 16. Open Nova Chrysalia and install the generated .ncmp modpack. It will appear in the `packs` folder of LRRandomizer 17. Launch the game from Nova Chrysalia in "Unpacked" mode with the "Voice Over Settings" matching the language you unpacked game data for.
### AP LR FF13 Client
1. Launch the game 2. Run the Archipelago Launcher (ArchipelagoLauncher.exe) 3. Click `Lightning Returns Final Fantasy XIII Client` 4. Connect to your room with the correct port and player name
**WARNING:** Loading any other saves while connected to the client may send some unexpected checks to the server. Be careful not load any other saves.

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r2
entry.content:
The first major release is here! The main additions are adding Wondersanity options (both world and national separately) and spawning Great People when GPsanity is on. In particular I'd appreciate testing of the Wondersanity stuff, as it's hard to conclusively test that.
### Changelog: - Two separate Wondersanity options add World Wonders and/or National Wonders into the location pool. Building the wonder sends a location check, and you can build the wonder even if it's obsolete (though you won't get any benefits other than the culture). - Great People are added to the itempool when GPsanity is enabled. The total number of added great people is half the GPsanity number rounded up per type (so at the default of 3 checks, 2 of each GP type are added). These aren't progression (just useful), so it doesn't fully solve the large check number possibility, but it should help a lot, especially at lower numbers. - You can't receive technologies from goody huts or normal GP bulbs if Techsanity is enabled.
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.title: Final Fantasy 1 PSP v0.2.0
entry.content: --- # New Features ## 📖 Bestiarysanity — monsters hold checks Turn a percentage of the seed's huntable monsters into AP locations. Kill one, get a check. - Logic handles which monsters are reachable with your items and yaml settings. **New Bestiary tab in the AP client** - Monsters grouped by where you can hunt them. - A section lights up when reachable right now, and grays out when you have cleared it. - Clear over half of a section to reveal the quality of items hidden behind the other monsters there. ## 💣 Traps Replace some of your filler items with traps. Traps spring at the start of your next battle as a **real monster ability**, animated and announced the way the game does it normally. Available traps so far: - 🤐 **Silence Trap** - 🦑 **Ink Trap** - 🧪 **Poison Darts Trap** - 💀 **Death Trap** Because they are real abilities, they can be dodged and resisted like anything else a monster throws at you. ## 👥 Missing Party Members **Choose Starting Party Size** - The rest go **MISSING**: fully removed from the party, and enter the multiworld item pool as items named for their job. - A joining member rapidly gains levels at their first battle victory. - Logic knows your party is short, so a 1-member start does not get asked to do 4-member things. ## 🥷 Custom Job Sprite Special thanks to @✨-Prime-✨ for commissioning the fully custom Stealth Thief and Stealth Ninja Sprites. Get the scroll and your Thief sprite upgrades in game! --- ### ⬆️ Quality of Life - **Item and location name groups.** `!hint`, `exclude_locations`, `priority_locations`, and plando now take group names instead of 323 item names and 452 location names typed out one at a time. 13 item groups (Party Members, Key Items, Weapons, Armor, Equipment, Consumables, Spell Tomes with a White/Black split, Job Scrolls, Vehicles, Assembly Pieces, Gil, Experience Bags) and 35 location groups (Chests, Shops, NPCs, one per dungeon or town, plus Bonus Dungeons). ### 🪰 Bugfixes related to... - Thief steal crashes. - Vanishing party members. - Grand Master gaining attack by lethal attacks.* - Blood Knight lifesteal on undead. - Bonus dungeon chests past the 65th.* - Wrong-disc detection. - Battle turn-order wraparound fix, dynamic chest name fixes, and a pile of smaller client stability fixes. --- ⚠️ Not compatible with existing seeds. Finish the seed you're playing on the version that generated it and then upgrade. --- ## Something Broke? Run `/logs` in the client's command box and drop it into Discord for fastest results. - Bug reports: [Issues](https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/issues) - Discussion and support: [FF1 PSP Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1500609270620885032) - Not in the main AP server yet? [Archipelago Discord](https://discord.gg/archipelago) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/1-800-thewolf/FF1PSP-Archipelago/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.1.0r2
entry.content:
# v2.1.0: Various Misc. Things *Intended for use with game mod version 14 (see attachments).*
v2.1.0 contains a handful of new settings, tweaks, and fixes without any particular theming. It's mostly stuff that came up during or shortly after development of v2.0.0 that were either low priority or I otherwise didn't manage to get into an update until now.
⚠ Even if you downloaded the v2.1.0 prerelease, please update your .apworld file with the version here. A logic adjustment and some minor client bugfixes were added to this full version of v2.1.0 that you will miss out on if you don't install the new .apworld below. The game mod is unchanged and can be ignore if you already have version 14.0 of it. ⚠
### Additions/Expansions - New `automatic` setting to `boss_lair_forcing` which forces all goal boss to have collectively the highest cost(s). - Expanded location groups to include per-level and per-realm groups, as well as adding a "Starter Checks" group. - `movement_randomization` now allows for individual randomization of each ability, instead of being all or nothing. - Renamed `starting_breath` -> `starting_breaths` to reflect it now allowing for starting with multiple breaths. Can still start with none or with a random breath, if the list is left empty. - Random breath does **not** require `auto_corrections` to be set to 'fix'. `starting_realms` was adjusted to be similar in not requiring `auto_corrections` anymore to get a random realm chosen.
### Fixes - Fixed `vanilla_minigame_rewards` not working for turret minigames. - Fixed a missing glide requirement in Dragonfly Falls connecting the end of the level back to the start. - Improved error handling in `/check_goal` command.
### Tweaks - Removed glide requirement from the locked chest in the entry area of Dragonfly Falls, as it can be reached from below with just Double Jump quite easily. Similarly adjusted the gem access rule for the Crocovile next to it. - "Generics" filler item selection process is improved to be more uniform. Each one will be picked once before any are doubled up, and similar as more are picked.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)

entry.title: Haste v0.5.1
entry.content:
The first revision to the fifth major release of the Haste Archipelago
You will need to subscribe to and enable the [Mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3462307025) on Steam.
## Logic Changes - The Triangular Distribution for Fragmentsanity can **no longer** be enabled with Dynamic Per-Shard Fragmentsanity, due to an emerging concern over seeds taking dozens of hours to finish a single late-game Shard's worth of fragment clears if the scaling was high enough - Triangular Distribution can still be used with Static Per-Shard and Global Fragmentsanities, and Balanced Triangular is unaffected - This restriction may be revisited at a later time, due to Triangular being a "landmine" setting that can catastrophically blow up expected seed times with certain combinations of settings - As an example: - With the maximum Dynamic Scaling of 200%, there would be **66** checks in Disaster Shard 2 (and onward), and would require **2211 Fragment clears** to attain - At a *generously* estimated 40 seconds per Fragment, it would roughly **24.5 hours** to complete *just* D2's Fragmentsanity checks - With the same scaling, Shard 1's 26 checks would take **3.9 hours** to complete - In total, from Shard 1 to D2, it would take at best **~120 hours** to do all 482 checks - **This is an unreasonable ask in basically any scenario** - However, at 100% scaling, it would take **30 hours** to complete its 241 checks. This is still a large value, but could hypothetically be playable in long asyncs
## Bugfixes - Fixed Shopsanity Scaling accidentally using Fragmentsanity Scaling's value in the slot data
